title: Security & Data (LMG)
activity: CCTV, access control, containment, structured cabling
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Door hardware fitted by others correct and undamaged before connection?
Locks, door monitoring and readers fitted and connected with the correct cable?
ACS cabinets installed with local power checked?
Brackets, mounts and cameras secure, in the right positions and views as agreed?
Cameras fitted, aimed correctly and undamaged?
Containment fixed with end caps and edge trim; copex taken to containment?
Readers, door contacts and break-glass units installed and connected at each access door?
questions.source: LMG security ITP 00002–00005 – ACS device checklist 3–10

questions.q: Request-to-exit and mag lock/strike fitted and connected where scheduled?
questions.source: LMG security ITP 00002–00005 – ACS device checklist 6–14

questions.q: Camera power (PoE) live and the view agreed with the client?
Panic buttons and intruder devices cabled (grade 3 star wiring)?
